sections.appearance: She has long silver hair tied in braids with beige ribbon in her left side and a black Gehenna admiral hat with a Gehenna badge strapped with black and white suspender. She has a black demon wing with a gold piercing and sharp red eyes. Halo ==== Haruna's halo has a red double crosshair with a four needles inside a smaller circle in four cardinal directions. This might possibly be a sniper sight aiming at a silver platter. Uniform ==== She wears a standard uniform, consisting of a black coat with silver inner wear, red ends and black armband on her left sleeve, a white collared uniform shirt with cuffed black buttons and a black tie with two gold star pins. She wears a black corset with white buttons, a pant skirt with red linings, black stockings with black high heels and carries a small beige handbag with ribbon and a taiyaki keychain. Firearm ==== thumb|Ideal|150px She uses a black H&K PSG-1 sniper rifle with a gold pistol grip and a leather brown cheek rest. The Gehenna insignia is imprinted on the receiver.

sections.personality: Unlike other members of the Gourmet Research Club, Haruna is greatly concerned with the form and ceremony of a meal. She looks at the atmosphere of her meals, how they are prepared, what ingredients and tools are used, where she eats. The idea is that through all of this, her food will taste even better. She is usually prim and proper, but her passion for food often turns destructive: If a meal or establishment doesn't satisfy her, her retribution will be painful. Usually in the form of high explosives...
